title: Task
description: The unit of assignment. Issued by the Manager, tightly scoped and self-contained: the assignee cannot see the conversation that produced it and must not spend budget re-deriving it.

assignee_instance.description: Set at assignment; must differ from author_instance for review/QE tasks.

author_instance.description: Instance that produced the artifact under review or test.

problem.description: What is wrong or missing, in behaviour terms.

relevant_paths.description: Where to start reading. Saves the assignee an exploration budget.

prior_decisions.description: ADR ids, PRD sections, ruling ids that bind this task.

memory_refs.description: Memory entries that apply. The assignee reads these before starting.

repo_brief.description: Path to this repo's brief. Buys back the orientation budget; required for a cold repo.

commands.description: Build/test commands for this repo, copied from the workspace. An agent discovering these is a workspace the Manager failed to fill in.

contract.description: Contract id this task implements or consumes, if any.

acceptance_criteria.description: More than five means this is not one task. Split it.

source.description: PRD section or PM ruling this came from.

write_paths.description: Complete set of files the assignee may modify, each qualified with the repo id ('api:src/auth.ts'). More than three means split the task. Must be disjoint from any concurrently assigned task ACROSS the whole workspace.

budget.description: Hard ceilings. Warn at 70%, stop at 100% and request a specific extension.

granted_extension.description: What the Manager granted and why. Extensions are specific amounts with reasons, never 'carry on'.

cold_repo_uplift.description: Extra tool calls granted for orientation in a repo the team has not worked in. Repaid by returning repo-brief material.

out_of_scope.description: Named explicitly so the assignee does not widen the task.

asked_directly.description: Agents ask owners directly; the Manager is cc'd, not in the path.

lifecycle.description: Populated by the Manager across respawns.

respawn_count.description: Two respawns maximum. After that the task is rescoped or escalated.

respawn_brief.description: From the terminated agent's SELF_STUCK message. The replacement reads ruled_out first.

ruled_out.description: Paths the replacement must not re-attempt. The most valuable field on this team.

spend_history.description: Actual spend per attempt. Feeds the Manager's sizing of future tasks.

repo.description: Workspace repo id this task is deployed into. Exactly one — an agent works in one repo per task. 'integration' is reserved for the cross-repo verification task, which reads everywhere and writes in one place.
